biography.value: The Swamp Beast is old enough that the swamp has stopped being its habitat and started being its body.

system.tactics:
The Swamp Beast begins most encounters already in position, motionless and indistinguishable from the surrounding mire. It waits until something comes within 10 feet before erupting.
Its priority is Engulf. Once something is engulfed, it releases the spore cloud to deter the target's allies  grinding down the engulfed creature with automatic damage each round while slamming anything that gets close.
Spit Acid is its only ranged option and it uses it on clustered groups or when melee is temporarily unavailable.
Grasping Roots targets ranged attackers or spellcasters the Beast can perceive through Blindsight, pinning them in place. It does not retreat. It does not recognize the concept.
system.attacksNotes:
Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7), Reach 10 ft. (Large creature)

  • Margin 1:: 16 damage (10 + 6 Str)
  • Margin 2: 16 damage, DR halved (round up)

Engulf Trigger: If two Swamp Beast slam ### Attacks hit the same Medium or smaller target in the same turn, the Swamp Beast immediately uses Engulf on that target as a [Free] action.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Blindsight: The Swamp Beast perceives its surroundings through vibration and chemical detection within 60 feet. It cannot perceive anything beyond this radius and is effectively blind to it. The [Hidden] condition does not apply to creatures within 60 feet, though they still gain [Concealed] against the Beast's ### Attacks. Lightning Absorption: The Swamp Beast is immune to lightning damage. Whenever it would take lightning damage, it instead regains HP equal to the damage that would have been dealt. This recovery cannot exceed its maximum HP. Lightning Surge: When the Swamp Beast absorbs lightning damage, in addition to recovering HP it gains temporary HP equal to half the absorbed amount (rounded down) until the start of its next turn. These temporary HP are lost at the start of its next turn regardless of whether they were depleted. False Appearance: While the Swamp Beast remains motionless in swamp terrain, it is indistinguishable from a mound of rotting vegetation. A creature that succeeds on a Perception [Hard] check notices something wrong before the Beast moves. Engulf [Free]: Triggered when two slams hit the same Medium or smaller target. The Swamp Beast engulfs the target, drawing it into its mass. The engulfed creature gains the Blinded, Restrained, and Bound conditions simultaneously and cannot breathe. At the start of each of the Swamp Beast's turns, an engulfed creature makes a Fortitude save, opposed by the Beast's Con 6 + Wis 3). On failure, the creature takes 12 bludgeoning damage. On success, no damage that turn. The Swamp Beast can have only one creature engulfed at a time. The engulfed creature moves with the Beast when it moves. To escape, the creature must win an opposed Athletics or Acrobatics check against the Beast's Might 5 + Str 6 on its turn, spending a [Combat] action . An adjacent ally may attempt the same check as a [Combat] action to pull the engulfed creature free. The engulfed creature is released immediately if the Swamp Beast is reduced to 0 HP. Spit Acid (Recharge 5–8) [Combat]: Costs 2 actions. The Beast expels a stream of acidic fluid in a 15-foot cone. Every creature in the area makes a Reflex save, opposed by the Beast's Con 6 + Wis 3. Creatures that fail take 28 acid damage (half DR). Creatures that succeed take 14 acid damage. Resistances and Immunities Immunities: Lightning damage (see Lightning Absorption), Blinded condition, Deafened condition, Exhaustion Resistances: Cold damage and fire damage — reduce incoming damage of these types by 4. The Beast's dense wet mass insulates against both extremes. Lair Feature: Living Swamp While the Swamp Beast is in its territory and conscious, the swamp around it responds as an extension of its body. At the start of each round, the Beast may cause one of the following effects without spending any of its actions. Only one effect may be active at a time; triggering a new one ends the previous. Grasping Roots: Up to three roots or vines erupt from the ground at points the Beast can perceive within 60 feet. Each root targets one creature. Each targeted creature makes a Reflex save, opposed by the Beast's Might 5 + Con 6. Creatures that fail are Restrained. Each root is a separate object: HP 12, DR 2, immune to poison and psychic damage. A root disappears when reduced to 0 HP, when the Beast triggers a different lair effect, or when the Beast dies. A Restrained creature is released when its root is destroyed. Spore Cloud: A cloud of toxic spores fills a 20-foot diameter sphere centered on a point the Beast can perceive within 60 feet. The cloud does not move once placed. Every creature in the cloud when it appears makes a Fortitude save, opposed by the Beast's Con 6 + Wis 3. Creatures that fail take 16 poison damage. Creatures that succeed take 8 poison damage. All creatures within the cloud gain the Blinded condition while inside it. The cloud persists until the Beast triggers a different lair effect or dies. When the Swamp Beast dies, all active lair effects end immediately and the roots collapse. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
